title: kbmon tells what is true: overlap ages and decisions, claim-only overlaps, stall alerts, span exports, the mod's baseline and cut rows
goal: kbmon's sessions panel, exports and mod report what is true: an overlap's age counts from the newest intent, a coordinate event decides it only when its sessions posted it after it began, and claim-only overlaps show; the sessions panel reads only the coord kinds it needs, binds a workspace hook's state files and starts a bounded number of git processes; KbmonRunStalled fires only for a dead or silent worker, kb.sprint is exported once, a run's trace id does not depend on the export time, kb.item ids do not collide across stores and a refused landing with its rework is one kb.item span; wait/ leases are not claims and --status all shows every active sprint's run-state row; the mod tells a disk entry once, takes its baseline from the first complete reading and tells nothing for a cut row; kbwho --otel-attributes drops an email in the service name, mon_eta counts a paid bench item as bench, and a loopback receiver posts each Alertmanager alert as a coord ask
